summary: AISDLC-805 resume (PR #1392) blocked: next-step cannot re-enter the existing worktree

options.description: Run /ai-sdlc cleanup AISDLC-805 (risks discarding unpushed worktree state), then re-dispatch
File a fix so next-step re-enters an existing worktree/branch on a resumed task

body:
taskId: AISDLC-805
sourceWorktree: /Users/dominique/Documents/dev/ai-sdlc/ai-sdlc/.worktrees/aisdlc-805

From the main checkout, next-step --fresh fails: git worktree add refuses because .worktrees/aisdlc-805 exists (it computes branch ai-sdlc/aisdlc-805-audit-every-requirement-..., but the real branch is ai-sdlc/aisdlc-805). From the worktree, next-step reports 'no task file for AISDLC-805' though backlog/tasks/aisdlc-805 - ... .md exists there. The worktree has one uncommitted deletion of an old attestation envelope. Nothing was modified by me.
